rows: Scope

Bulgaria. The register names 3,597 offices from all 265 municipalities and the 2023 district/village roster. Archived official CIK pages recover 1,776 usable 2015 village/district histories, including 1,555 exact candidate-vote vectors and 221 percentage-only vectors. First rounds and runoffs are one cycle. Some archived pages, older histories and decisive outcomes remain missing; unresolved first rounds are excluded from completed histories. Original certificates, final 2027 village eligibility and announcements after the 28 August replacement-register snapshot remain unverified.
Election window
8 September 2026 to 8 March 2028 inclusive. Source checks and import review through 11 September 2026. Later election announcements require a refresh.
Availability is not completeness

Three historical entries do not certify three complete, comparable, final or latest valid election events. Read the result coverage and country notes. Predecessor, preliminary, seat-only, unopposed and multi-mark records are expressly identified.
What is an office?

One elected institution or executive post. A municipality can have a mayor and a council row; a community can have an additional council. These are not counts of unique municipalities or polling days.
Competition

Eligible top-two gap in percentage points. Weighted gap = 60% latest + 30% middle + 10% oldest. Score = max(0,100 × (1 − weighted gap / 20)). A latest gap ≤5 or weighted gap ≤10 is a historical flag, not a victory probability. Legislative list gaps do not determine governing majorities.
Volatility

Grouped Pedersen = half the sum of absolute changes in validated party-group shares, averaged over two intervals. Pooled residual/local-party categories imply a lower bound. Margin dispersion is the population standard deviation of three eligible gaps and is separate from electorate switching.
Recalculation

Weights and thresholds on Parameters are editable. The Office register recalculates from the normalized gap and Pedersen inputs. Editing a raw return requires rebuilding the normalized input; edits do not automatically propagate between separate files.
Polling and control

National polls are conditional context. Local governing arrangements, coalition support and source age matter. Beyond 180 days the poll is early context only. Missing evidence means unassessed, not safe government.
Detailed returns
This file contains all imported historical candidate/list returns for this country, including regional records where present. A vote/mark basis is stated for each row.
Ongoing and partial elections

Sobótka’s September first round is outside completed history. Polish council replacements involve ward subsets and are not municipality-wide competition series. Slovenian community marks are not unique voters.
Structural changes

Norway one-to-one code changes are reconciled; mergers and splits are not invented. Belinho has one current-parish return and two former-parish context returns. Slovenia’s community roster is provisional for 2026. Moldova’s future municipal map is unresolved; its 1,822 additional legacy offices are excluded from active race totals.
Source status

Sources are linked in each result table. A preliminary return remains preliminary even when all numeric rows are present. Vechtstromen 2013 is unscored pending the final certificate. Current-control fields preserve their source dates.
Remaining inventory gaps

Several lower local tiers remain incomplete, including other Swiss municipalities, UK parish/town councils, Moldova’s future map and rolling parish/vacancy registers. Bulgarian archives improve the historical coverage but do not establish the final 2027 village roster. No European completion percentage is asserted.
